messages:
Marta (Nimbus): Quick flag for CS - our QA sees 429s during onboarding when testers open multiple app windows using the staging key `stg-nimbus-77`. Browser SDK init triggers it.
Theo Ramos: Hi Marta, can you share the SDK call pattern? is init calling preflight each time?
Marta (Nimbus): Yes, each window runs `Redwood.init({ key: 'stg-nimbus-77' })` on load. If 3+ windows nearly-simultaneous we get 429.
Ivy Chen: That matches our preflight short-burst limiter for browser api_keys. We throttle preflight to protect token service. We prefer session token exchange or dedupe in SDK.
onboard-bot: Account Nimbus trial started 2026-06-05 11:00 UTC
Theo Ramos: Short-term options: 1) we can apply a 12-hour staging uplift for that key, 2) quick frontend change to exchange a session token from server and store in localStorage so new windows reuse it. Which do you want?
Marta (Nimbus): Could you enable the uplift for the next 8 hours? We'll also push a tiny patch to exchange tokens.
Ivy Chen: Uplift done for stg-nimbus-77, logged in OPS ticket 12034. Also adding a note for SDK team to include a `dedupePreflight` flag in next release.
Theo Ramos: For repro, run in console: `for(i=0;i<6;i++)fetch('/v1/preflight',{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer stg-nimbus-77'}}).then(r=>r.status.then){}` — sorry pseudo-code, but basically hammering preflight shows mixture of 200/429.
Marta (Nimbus): After uplift I retried with 6 windows, no 429s. We'll implement session exchange tomorrow following Ivy's snippet.
Ivy Chen: Follow-ups: add onboarding doc blurb about avoiding synchronous multiple window inits, SDK patch will add preflight dedupe, and infra will consider session-scoped limiter instead of api_key for browser flows.
Marta (Nimbus): Thanks all — closing on our side once patch deployed.
